findings.description: All four primary list pages were downloaded from https URLs with the specified curl command (retrieved 2026-11-25 UTC, after brief.created_at 2026-11-25T02:22:03Z). Hashes are SHA-256 of the downloaded bytes.

Enumeration: Core Faculty 19 names, Affiliated Faculty 26, Visiting and Emeritus 4, Research Scientists 2; total 51 distinct people. Compared with brief.people by name: no omissions in either direction, no duplicates across lists, and no person listed under two headings.
No announced incoming appointments appear on any of the four list pages, so no incoming subtotal applies and effective_from_json is null for all records. Historical start dates were not inferred.

Profile pages were not fetched. Decisions rest on the titles and section headings printed on the four official department list pages, which the instructions allow as the primary evidence. No profile was required to resolve any person.
